## Machine-readable content

This site serves clean markdown to AI agents on request. Send an `Accept: text/markdown` header when fetching any page URL to receive a CommonMark version instead of HTML, at the same URL. No separate endpoint or path change is needed.

This file and the markdown-negotiation behavior described above are provided by [MDF Analytics](https://github.com/bitcryptic-gw/mdf-analytics-wp), an implementation of the [MDF (Markdown First)](https://github.com/bitcryptic-gw/mdf) open standard.
